additional_source_basis: Prior full source-first/current-record and auxiliary rereads of235–236,247–256,267–273,277–280,291; frozen availability and source-scope policy.

rows.review_disposition: Political labels provide useful retrieval but cannot imply disciplined timeless membership. The explicit235–236 account of fluid circles governs the surrounding terminology.

253/257–259 distinguish judicial sentences, custody deaths, unrecorded killings, an estimated wider total excluding Vendée, and debated Vendéan losses. Preserve units, periods, geography and modal language.
251/258/266 describe multiple initiatives and emergent control problems; later centralization does not retrospectively prove a single architect. Preserve phase and institutional roles.
267–270 distinguish real radical agitation from fabricated/speculative foreign-plot and famine allegations. Hébertist access cannot turn prosecution rhetoric into factual membership or direction.
257 directly supports Carrier’s approval of drownings/shootings;258 describes subordinate blame-shifting at recall. Preserve both responsibility and the limits of later self-protective denunciations.
271 limits the apparent ending to autonomous sansculotte instruments; subsequent centralized Terror intensifies. March–April is a transformation, not a universal endpoint.
Federalist is a qualified contemporary label; punitive treatment differed by locality and does not establish one rebel ideology.
257–259 numerical populations overlap only partly and must not be summed or conflated. Preserve the wider estimate’s explicit exclusion of Vendée.

257 says a quarter million rebel-side deaths does not seem an overestimate while acknowledging historians’ disagreement; the regional population recovered only in the1820s. Demographic recovery and violent deaths are distinct measures.
257 gives perhaps1,800 drownings, distinct from3,548 departmental capital sentences and other shootings. Preserve approximation and method.
267/270 conspiracy rhetoric contains attributed allegations; do not infer a comprehensive foreign-directed plot from prosecution claims.
266 recalls an emergent Terror and lack of overall control, while later concrete measures centralize it. Preserve an evolving system rather than denying anyone’s responsibility.
Word-count reproducibility is administrative measurement metadata, not a semantic source uncertainty. Retire this duplicate while binding the reviewed measurement separately.
Unavailable endnotes bound the claim to supplied eligible text. Page-reading coverage remains distinct from completed entity and final-value review.
274 explicitly says reliable motivation evidence is almost absent and cautiously interprets feared potential. Retain uncertainty while preserving the documented trial manipulation and execution.
281 rejects actual dictatorship and reliable evidence of a dictatorial aim while explaining contemporary fear and retrospective blame. Access may include the accusation only with that stance.
276 offers three alternatives: coincidence, anti-Christian challenge, or conciliation. Repair the issue field’s incomplete two-way formulation to agree with its handling.
292–293 identify royalist organizations in some regions but broader vengeance and local vendetta. Neither entirely apolitical nor centrally directed royalist descriptions are sufficient.
289–290 distinguish generous formal terms from Charette’s isolation and others’ tactical delay awaiting Britain. Temporary peace cannot mean final pacification or identical private intentions.
276 supplies all three Whit Sunday interpretations; the corrected page must remain276 and no intent may be selected as certain.
281 explicitly rejects wages as the only reason for popular nonmobilization: sudden crisis, lack of planning and accepted accusations also mattered.
281 distinguishes dictatorship accusation, fear of inflexible power and later scapegoating from authorial rejection of proven dictatorship. Keep that evidentiary hierarchy.
275 says social discrimination came closer and some died for status, without establishing general innocence or an absolute class-extermination policy. Preserve the tentative inference.
290 makes different private calculations explicit: Charette feared isolation, while others sought time for British assistance. Formal terms and tactical purposes both need retention.
292–293 require named royalist formations alongside predominantly revenge-driven violence, regional concentration and approximate losses.
